title: Spending the $1.6 billion federal recovery grant
summary: Maui County is spending $1.6 billion in HUD disaster recovery block grants, mostly on housing. By August, $1.39 billion was set aside for programs, and spending is projected through 2031. The money funds first-time buyer help, single-family rebuilds and multifamily rebuilds such as the French Street Apartments. Staff named rising infrastructure costs as a key risk.

timeline.text: The chair deferred the disaster recovery item.
timeline.body: County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

timeline.text: Staff said the funding for multifamily rebuilds requires them to give fire survivors priority to move back.
